infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the utility room of the OLI outlet store on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: OLI outlet utility room key (OLI util.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the OLI store outlet utility room at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs
